Jellyfin.PORT: Jellyfin web and API listener used by Railway health checks. Must stay 8096.
Jellyfin.UPLOAD_PORT: Private dufs upload server listener reached only through the gateway at /files/.
Jellyfin.JELLYFIN_ADMIN_USERNAME: Jellyfin administrator created on first boot. Changing it later has no effect.
Jellyfin.JELLYFIN_ADMIN_PASSWORD: Generated password of the first-boot Jellyfin administrator. Change it in Jellyfin afterwards; editing this variable later has no effect.

Jellyfin Gateway.GATEWAY_PASSWORD: Generated password for the /files/ upload manager (16 to 72 bytes).
Jellyfin Gateway.JELLYFIN_UPSTREAM: Private Jellyfin web and API endpoint.
Jellyfin Gateway.GATEWAY_CONFIG: Pinned Caddy policy: Basic Auth on /files/, Jellyfin's own login everywhere else.
